اهتلكتما (form VIII)
# اِهْتَلَكْتُمَا (ihtalaktumā) /ih.ta.lak.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# اُهْتُلِكْتُمَا (uhtuliktumā) /uh.tu.lik.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
